# allow-api.txt: the names of the declarations of SwiftSoup that stay `public`
# in Vendor/SwiftSoup, because TextMouth or its tests call them, or Swift
# requires them to be public beside one that is called. Every other `public`
# or `open` in the release becomes internal, and the compiler drops what is
# then unreachable. One name a line; a name stands for every declaration of
# that name (an override keeps its base's access); `#` starts a comment.
#
# To add one: a build or a test says "'x' is inaccessible due to 'internal'
# protection level"; add x here and run make_vendor.py. To find what the app
# calls, read every call site of the files that `import SwiftSoup` in
# TextMouth/ and TextMouthProductionTests/.
#
